<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Speaker's Defense](/Feats.aspx?ID=5335) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33

**Prerequisites**
[Budding Speaker Centaur](/Heritages.aspx?ID=292) heritage or [Speaker in Training](/Feats.aspx?ID=5330)

</column>

---

As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people. If you're a Faithspeaker, you can call on gods or powerful planar beings to cast [_share life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1669) and [_status_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1690), each once per day as innate divine spells; if you're a Greenspeaker, you can call on the forces of nature to cast [_entangling flora_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1515) and [_environmental endurance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1517), each once per day as innate primal spells.

prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
